node.title: Re^3: Privilege reduction with start_server / plackup
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
It's Twiggy for the non-blocking.

Ah, yes, I see, and I think you're right that Starman doesn't support that. It looks like neither [mod://Server::Starter] or [mod://Twiggy] support changing the UID/GID natively. What I learned in writing the script I linked to was that it basically has to be done by the server itself, and not by some tool launching that server, because it first needs to open the ports, and then reduce its privileges. You could of course consider putting the server behind an nginx proxy, but that's also an extra component to maintain. [https://bitbucket.org/haukex/hgpstools/src/d1febe1fd802019/serialdaemon_gps.pl#lines-303|Here's] a sub I wrote once to manually set the UID and GID with as much error checking as possible.
